description: Popis ulica Grada Belog Manastira is a dataset listed in Open Data Portal Croatia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Grad Beli Manastir. List of streets of the City of Beli Manastir with markings of cadastral parcels, cadastral municipalities and street status. Coverage: Grad Beli Manastir. The portal shows the English title as "List of streets of the town of Beli Manastir" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Grad Beli Manastir. Its keywords include katastarske čestice, javna uprava, ulice. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Other (Public Domain). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-portal-otvorenih-podataka.
